$comment: Deep Well (tools/deep_well_content.mjs, Scripts/DeepWell/DeepWell.cs): a powered, worker-free, waterproof rig whose drill cell hangs over a native map water source and boosts it. Checked by tools/validate_deep_well_content.mjs.
Cost: the late-game rule (tools/building_construction_costs.json lategameTier.DeepWell, lategameGates.DeepWell); science here, inside that tier's band.
Power: powerInputHp at maxBoost; the native MechanicalNode input multiplier is boost / maxBoost (1x = powerInputHp / maxBoost).
Drill bits: the native GoodConsumingBuilding at perBoostStepPerHour x boost; the blueprint carries the full-boost rate, which sizes its inventory (ceil(rate x fullInventoryWorkHours)).
